data.body: 549b change 2552 patchset 3: LLM-Review+1 PASS (5 advisories) but CI Verified-1 — repo-wide ARG-backlog ratchet (test_arg_sweep_kwargs_heldout.py) capped at 25 unused-arg findings; _eligible_reviews's unused criterion_id param pushed it to 26 (== LLM advisory #3, maintainability).
